source: 上外版必修第二册 Unit 1 Glossary 真词(跳过△超纲词与专有名词);IPA 英音标准词典回填;例句原创、自然/生态主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: We should learn to live in harmony with nature.
words.example_cn: 我们应该学会与大自然和谐相处。

words.meaning_cn: 原产于某地的;土生的;当地的
words.example_en: These flowers are native to this part of the world.
words.example_cn: 这些花原产于世界的这一带。

words.example_en: Many rare plants only grow in this forest.
words.example_cn: 许多稀有植物只生长在这片森林里。

words.example_en: Tiny insects help the flowers grow in the garden.
words.example_cn: 小昆虫帮助花园里的花生长。

words.example_en: Every creature plays a part in the balance of nature.
words.example_cn: 每一种生物都在自然的平衡中发挥作用。

words.example_en: People should not destroy the homes of wild animals.
words.example_cn: 人们不应该破坏野生动物的家园。

words.example_en: The balance of nature is delicate and easy to break.
words.example_cn: 自然的平衡很脆弱,容易被打破。

words.example_en: We are damaging the natural world far too fast.
words.example_cn: 我们破坏自然界的速度太快了。

words.example_en: Some damage to nature may soon be beyond repair.
words.example_cn: 对自然的某些破坏可能很快就无法修复了。

words.example_en: We must protect nature for future generations.
words.example_cn: 我们必须为子孙后代保护大自然。

words.example_en: It is our duty to preserve wild forests and rivers.
words.example_cn: 保护原始森林和河流是我们的责任。

words.example_en: Learn to appreciate the beauty all around us in nature.
words.example_cn: 学会欣赏我们身边大自然的美。

words.example_en: Snow can transform a familiar landscape into a white wonderland.
words.example_cn: 雪能把熟悉的景色变成银白的仙境。

words.example_en: The hill near my home is a familiar sight to me.
words.example_cn: 我家附近的小山对我来说是熟悉的景象。

words.example_en: The painter loved to draw the landscape of the countryside.
words.example_cn: 这位画家喜欢画乡村的风景。

words.example_en: The weather can deeply affect the way we feel.
words.example_cn: 天气会深深影响我们的感受。

words.example_en: A sunny morning often puts me in a good mood.
words.example_cn: 阳光明媚的早晨常让我心情很好。

words.meaning_cn: 作为原因的;有责任的;负责的
words.example_en: Nature is responsible for the sun, rain and snow.
words.example_cn: 自然带来了阳光、雨水和雪。

words.meaning_cn: 浪漫的;富有情调的;美妙的
words.example_en: The moonlight over the lake made the night feel romantic.
words.example_cn: 湖面上的月光让这个夜晚显得很浪漫。

words.example_en: In spring a small flower pushes through the frozen ground.
words.example_cn: 春天里,一朵小花从冻硬的土地中钻出。

words.meaning_cn: 知道的;意识到的;明白的
words.example_en: Becoming more aware of nature can change our lives.
words.example_cn: 更多地留意自然能够改变我们的生活。

words.example_en: Time in nature has a positive effect on our minds.
words.example_cn: 亲近自然对我们的心灵有积极的影响。

words.meaning_cn: 残酷的;残忍的;引起痛苦的
words.example_en: Some people think it is cruel to keep animals in cages.
words.example_cn: 有些人认为把动物关在笼子里很残忍。

words.example_en: We often debate whether zoos are good for animals.
words.example_cn: 我们常常争论动物园对动物是否有益。

words.example_en: Many people do not support these establishments at all.
words.example_cn: 许多人根本不支持这些机构。

words.example_en: Animal welfare is a growing concern in our society.
words.example_cn: 动物福利在我们的社会中越来越受关注。

words.example_en: The future of wild tigers is a serious concern.
words.example_cn: 野生老虎的未来令人深感忧虑。

words.example_en: Some people argue that zoos are cruel to animals.
words.example_cn: 有些人认为动物园对动物很残忍。

words.example_en: It is wrong to remove animals from their natural homes.
words.example_cn: 把动物从它们的自然家园中带走是不对的。

words.example_en: Each animal has its own natural habitat in the wild.
words.example_cn: 每种动物在野外都有自己的天然栖息地。

words.example_en: A bird kept in a cage cannot fly freely.
words.example_cn: 关在笼子里的鸟不能自由飞翔。

words.example_en: Wild animals must hunt for food every single day.
words.example_cn: 野生动物每天都必须觅食。

words.example_en: Additionally, some animals become unhappy in small spaces.
words.example_cn: 此外,有些动物在狭小的空间里会变得不快乐。

words.example_en: Zoos exhibit animals from all over the world.
words.example_cn: 动物园展出来自世界各地的动物。

words.example_en: Animals must adjust to different climates and seasons.
words.example_cn: 动物必须适应不同的气候和季节。

words.example_en: Some plants only flourish in a warm and wet climate.
words.example_cn: 有些植物只在温暖潮湿的气候中茁壮生长。

words.example_en: The zoo's location decides which animals can live there.
words.example_cn: 动物园的位置决定了哪些动物能在那里生活。

words.example_en: Workers design the park to look like a real habitat.
words.example_cn: 工人们把公园设计得像真正的栖息地。

words.example_en: Many rare animals are now close to extinction.
words.example_cn: 许多稀有动物如今濒临灭绝。

words.example_en: Conservation helps to keep the whole ecosystem healthy.
words.example_cn: 环境保护有助于保持整个生态系统的健康。

words.meaning_cn: 必不可少的;极其重要的
words.example_en: Clean water is essential for every living thing.
words.example_cn: 清洁的水对每一个生物都必不可少。

words.example_en: Pollution is a serious threat to wild plants and animals.
words.example_cn: 污染对野生动植物构成严重威胁。

words.example_en: These trees grow particularly well in warm valleys.
words.example_cn: 这些树在温暖的山谷里长得特别好。

words.example_en: Thousands of species exist together in this forest.
words.example_cn: 成千上万的物种共同生存在这片森林里。

words.example_en: Losing one species can put many others in danger.
words.example_cn: 失去一个物种会让许多其他物种陷入危险。

words.example_en: It takes many years to restore the balance of nature.
words.example_cn: 恢复自然的平衡需要很多年。
